commands.name: search-compounds
commands.summary: Keyword search of PubChem compounds (name, synonym, formula, etc.) with sorting and paging

commands.name: search-genes
commands.summary: Keyword search of PubChem gene targets

commands.name: search-literature
commands.summary: Keyword search of literature (PubMed articles) linked to PubChem records

commands.name: count-search-hits
commands.summary: Count keyword hits in every PubChem collection (compound, substance, bioassay, gene, protein, taxonomy, pathway, cell, literature, patent)

commands.name: structure-search
commands.summary: Run an identity, similarity, substructure, superstructure or 3D-similarity search seeded by a compound CID. Returns the hit count and a cache key.

commands.name: resolve-name
commands.summary: Resolve a chemical name or identifier to PubChem records (preferred CID, RefChem); also reports whether the input is valid SMILES, SMARTS, InChI, etc.

commands.name: autocomplete
commands.summary: Autocomplete suggestions for compound, gene or taxonomy names from a prefix

commands.name: get-compound
commands.summary: Full PubChem compound summary record (names, identifiers, properties, safety, pharmacology, etc.) by CID

commands.name: get-gene
commands.summary: PubChem gene target record by NCBI Gene ID

commands.name: get-bioassay
commands.summary: PubChem bioassay record (description, protocol, targets, results summary) by AID

commands.name: get-element
commands.summary: PubChem element record (identifiers, properties, history, uses) by atomic number

commands.name: get-compound-structure
commands.summary: Compound structure record as JSON (atoms, bonds, 2D or 3D coordinates, computed props) by CID

commands.name: export-compound-sdf
commands.summary: Download a compound's 2D or 3D structure as SDF (MOL) text by CID

commands.name: list-elements
commands.summary: Periodic table: every element with symbol, mass, electron configuration, electronegativity, state, melting/boiling point, etc.

commands.name: list-classifications
commands.summary: List the classification hierarchies in the PubChem Classification Browser (MeSH, ChEBI, ATC, Compound TOC, ...) with their HIDs

commands.name: get-classification-node
commands.summary: Expand a classification hierarchy node to show its children and record counts

commands.name: list-sources
commands.summary: List all PubChem data sources (depositors) with substance/assay counts, category, organization, URL and license
